claims: The Artemis II splashdown is on Friday, April 10, 2026.
Live coverage starts around 6:30 p.m. EDT (3:30 p.m. PDT).
The Orion capsule is scheduled to land in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego at 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
Coverage will show the final descent.
NASA teams will be stationed to recover the crew.
The Los Angeles Times provides an in-depth guide on watching the splashdown.
